title: WenHai: a deep neural network forecasts the eddying ocean
summary: The WenHai data-driven global ocean forecast system outperforms a state-of-the-art eddy-resolving numerical model and an AI-based ocean forecast system for temperature and salinity profiles, sea surface temperature, sea level anomaly and near-surface currents at lead times from 1 day to at least 10 days. Skill beyond 10 days is not reported in the abstract, and the computational speed-up claimed in secondary coverage was not confirmed in the paper abstract.
ai_technology: WenHai deep neural network ocean forecasting model
organization: Laoshan Laboratory; Ocean University of China

evidence.tested: WenHai forecasts were compared with a state-of-the-art eddy-resolving numerical system and an AI-based system for temperature, salinity, sea surface temperature, sea level anomaly and currents at 1 to at least 10 day leads.
evidence.unknown: Skill beyond 10 days is not reported in the page read, and the authors describe ocean AI forecasting as remaining challenging.
evidence.ai_role: A data-driven deep neural network with bulk flux formulae, with ocean dynamics informing the architecture.
